The 2004 British Grand Prix, round 11 of the 2004 season at Silverstone on 11 July 2004, was won by Michael Schumacher driving for Ferrari. Kimi Räikkönen (McLaren) finished second and Rubens Barrichello (Ferrari) third.

ANSWER: Michael Schumacher
